metadata.description: A standalone, general-purpose developer kit for Claude Code: write, review, deploy, maintain, and debug. Phase one ships code-quality.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Language-agnostic coding standards, an on-demand quality review command, and automated lint/format/type gates via config.

plugins.name: journal-logger
plugins.description: An always-on, per-project journal of every change Claude makes (code, deploy, infra), with cross-session recap.
